notes.title: Beta Hotfix 5
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Enhanced AI Behavior: Friendly Crazy Karens and other allies now following the player when not engaged in combat.
[*]Performance: Optimized Lobby performance by over 50%, delivering smoother experiences, especially on older systems and Steam Deck.
[*]Visual Fix: Resolved cloth simulation issues for Karens.
[*]Audio Adjustment: Added distance-based falloff to Dwarf and Orc jump attack audio, preventing sounds from being heard across the entire map.
[*]Balance Tweaks: Reduced wolf spawn frequency for improved gameplay balance.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Hotfix 4
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed Crash on Enemy Spawn: Resolved a crash issue that occurred when spawning a specific enemy, addressing [b]multiple reports of dungeon crashes[/b].
[*]Improved Gamepad Cursor: Smoothed out cursor speed for consistent and responsive movement when using a gamepad.
[*]Fixed Enemy Spawn Issue: Corrected a bug that could prevent an enemy from spawning in certain rooms, ensuring a seamless experience.
[*]Persistent Weapons and Pickups: Weapons and pickups will no longer disappear after completing a wave triggered by a statue.
[*]Increased Green Shard Spawn Rate: Boosted the spawn frequency of green shards to enhance resource collection.
[/list]

[b]Please update Morgenstern to this version to be able to join Sessions. If there is a version miss-match you will be taken to the start screen. (the game shows the version number in the title screen)[/b]

More Bug Fixes, Balancing and AI improvements are coming soon...

notes.title: Beta Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*]Resolved Out of Bounds Issue: Fixed a bug where players and enemies would not die when falling out of level boundaries.
[*]Improved Room Lock Issue: Addressed a bug that caused players to get stuck in rooms. Note: Some rare edge cases may still occur.
[*]Fixed Terrain Clipping: Corrected an issue where large rocks in one area could clip into adjacent areas.
[*]Enemies in Dungeon not moving: Fixed a rare issue where enemies in the Dungeon would fail to move.
[*]Some minor fixes
[/list]

[b]PLease update Morgenstern to this version to be able to join Sessions. If there is a version miss-match you will be taken to the start screen.[/b]

More Bug Fixes, Balancing and Performance Updates are coming soon...

notes.title: Beta Hotfix 1
notes.content:
[list]
  [*]Removed Quick Join Button: Eliminated the "Quick Join" button to prevent players from accidentally joining sessions with high ping. High ping values are now color-coded (yellow for moderate, red for high) for better visibility.
  [*]Fixed Enemy and Room Unlock Bug: Resolved an issue where enemies could disappear, preventing rooms from unlocking.
  [*]Removed Debug Keybindings: Disabled debug keybindings (Z for spectator mode, M for save game deletion) to prevent unintended actions.
  [*]Fixed X-Axis Inversion: Corrected an issue where inverting the X-axis did not function properly.
  [*]PLease update Morgenstern to this version to be able to join Sessions. If there is a version miss-match you will be taken to the start screen.
[/list]

More Bug Fixes, Balancing and Performance Updates are coming soon...

[b]Thank you all for your Feedback![/b]
